name: Transformer tank earthing interface
aliases: switchyards Switchyard earthing and lightning interfaces
summary: Shows the assigned protective bond from the transformer tank to the station earthing network.
description: Shows the assigned protective bond from the transformer tank to the station earthing network. Earthing and lightning interfaces identify the connections between equipment metalwork, primary protection devices and the station earthing network. Their electrical purpose differs from their physical conductor route or electrode geometry.

In a switchyard arrangement, the earthing references help connect each primary equipment structure and surge-protection device to the correct earth-grid interface. Separate details show actual joints, sizes and installation routes. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Transformer tank earth terminal” at the input and “Station earth grid” at the output. Neutral earthing is a separate circuit function.
